title: Synthetic lethal CRISPR screen identifies a cancer cell-intrinsic role of PD-L1 in regulation of vulnerability to ferroptosis
contrast: PD-L1 KO (sgCD274) vs control (sgControl), 1 vs 1 (duplicates pooled)
paper_calls: No gene passes FDR in the deposited table; ferroptosis link from pathway enrichment
named_hits: No single-gene screen hits named; mechanism genes (SOD2, GPX4) are mid-list
verdict: Raw reads recovered exactly from the MAGeCK-normalized table. With one pooled library per arm, neither BARCS nor the paper's own MAGeCK calls any gene at FDR; the gene scores correlate 0.68. Screening-level, no replicate variation.
count_recovery: Raw reads = normalized / (one scale factor per sample); integrality 100.0% at k=1.
